title: Promises of God
definition: The promises of God are His faithful commitments revealed in Scripture, assuring His people of grace, presence, salvation, provision, and future hope.
summary: God's promises are trustworthy because God is faithful and true.
christFocus: All God's promises find their yes in Christ, who secures the hope and inheritance of His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's promises reveal His faithful commitment to His people. They give assurance, comfort, courage, correction, and hope because God cannot lie.

Promises must be read in context and received according to God's purposes. They are not blank checks for selfish desire, but trustworthy words from a faithful Father.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers are ruled by fear because they forget what God has promised. The promises of God matter because they anchor faith in God's character instead of circumstances.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Identify promises in Scripture and learn their context. Pray them back to God, trust His faithfulness, and encourage others with promises that point to Christ.
